div.p: The content of the CDC National Healthcare Safety Network (NHSN) Digital Quality Measures (dQM) implementation guide (IG) outlines the standards for electronically submitting surveillance data for Acute Care Hospital (ACH) Monthly and Respiratory Pathogens Surveillance (RPS) Daily dQMs. This IG complies with the NHSN dQM Reporting Implementation Guide, published by Health Level Seven International (HL7®) International for general requirements for submissions to NHSN.

The specifications in this IG define the standards for reporting the initial population that NHSN needs to calculate NHSN dQMs for ACH Monthly, RPS Daily, and the automated bed-capacity data-collection. These specifications will be updated when NHSN requirements change.
This IG does not define how to operationalize calculation of a specific NHSN measure or event of interest.
These specifications define the data content requirements for submissions for the ACH Monthly and RPS Daily dQMs to NHSN through NHSNLink.

This IG has the following dependencies:
HL7 FHIR NHSN dQM Reporting, Edition 1: https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/nhsn-dqm/artifacts.html
HL7 FHIR Release 4: https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/
US Core 3.1.1: http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/STU3.1.1/
QI Core 4.1.1: http://hl7.org/fhir/us/qicore/STU4.1.1/
Quality Measure IG 3.0.0: http://hl7.org/fhir/us/cqfmeasures/STU3/
Clinical Quality Framework Common FHIR Assets 4.0.1: http://fhir.org/guides/cqf/common/4.0.1/
Data Exchange for Quality Measures (DEQM) 3.1.0: http://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-deqm/STU3.1/
The audience for this work is all developers who want to enable their software systems to report surveillance data to the NHSN via FHIR dQMs.

Lantana Consulting Group produced and developed the content in this IG under contract to the Division of Healthcare Quality Promotion (DHQP) in the National Center for Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases (NCEZID) at the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).
